marks.gloss_en: בנין אב משלשתן: arbeh is not like chargol, nor chargol like arbeh, nor both like salam, nor salam like both; their common factor -- four legs, four wings, jumping legs, wings covering most of it -- so too any that has these, [even if its head is long]
one that comes and its head is long is [kosher]: so too any that has four legs, four wings, jumping legs, and whose wings cover most of it

פריך רב אחאי: מה להנך שכן אין ראשן ארוך -- Rav Achai: what of these? their heads are not long. [His own anticipated deflection, וכי תימא: כיון דשוו בארבע סימנין מייתינן ולא פרכינן -- since they agree in four signs we derive and do not refute -- he counters: אי הכי, חרגול נמי דשוו להו, לא ליכתוב ותיתי מארבה וסלעם! (65b.9) אלא איכא למיפרך: מה להנך שכן אין להן זנב; הכי נמי איכא למיפרך: מה להנך שכן אין ראשן ארוך. The pircha stands -- see header on why the deflection and counter are not structure.]
let the Merciful One not write 'salam' and let it be derived from arbeh and from chargol -- for what could you refute?
מה לארבה דאין לו גבחת -- what of arbeh? it has no gabachat
הרי חרגול דיש לו גבחת -- there is chargol, which has a gabachat
מה לחרגול דיש לו זנב -- what of chargol? it has a tail
הרי ארבה דאין לו זנב -- there is arbeh, which has no tail
דמאי פרכת? -- salam is derivable from arbeh and chargol (tzad_salam_mearbeh_vechargol), so writing it is superfluous
אם אינו ענין לגופו תנהו ענין לראשו ארוך -- Rav Achai's derivation of the long-headed grasshopper's permission
Rav Achai: salam is superfluous -- let the Merciful One not write 'salam', and let it be derived from arbeh and chargol
one that comes and has a gabachat -- from where? the verse says 'salam' -- this is the nippul
one that comes and has a tail -- from where? the verse says 'chargol' -- this is the rashon
but the tzartzur has four legs, four wings, jumping legs and wings covering most of it -- might it be permitted? the verse says 'chagav': its name must be chagav
if its name is chagav, might it be [kosher] without all these signs? the verse says 'leminehu': not until it has all these signs
